slides.heading: U1 — Home Dashboard
slides.note: Home dashboard serves as the central command cockpit for the shift.
steps: Access Home dashboard from main sidebar.
Review today's key performance metrics snapshot.
Monitor live active sales, open tables, and KOT counts.
Access quick-action shortcut tiles to operational modules.
Switch active branch or terminal language seamlessly.

slides.heading: U2 — Dine-in Floor Operations
slides.note: Visual floor plans show table statuses (Available, Seated, Billed).
steps: Tap Dine-in to view interactive floor layout.
Select dining area (Indoor, Outdoor, Family, VIP).
Tap table to seat guests and open ticket.
Add food items, apply customizers, and dispatch KOT to kitchen.
Manage table changes, merging, splits, and final settlement.

slides.heading: U3 — Payments & Unsettled Hub
slides.note: Clear all unsettled bills prior to conducting daily branch closing.
steps: Open Payments module to view all open tickets.
Filter tickets by channel (Dine-in, Takeaway, Delivery).
Select unsettled ticket to initiate checkout.
Process single or split tenders (Cash, Card, Voucher).
Finalize payment and print ZATCA-compliant fiscal receipt.

slides.heading: U4 — Takeaway & Quick Serve
slides.note: Optimized for minimal keystrokes during intense peak counter rushes.
steps: Tap Takeaway for fast over-the-counter ordering.
Fast-add popular menu items directly to ticket.
Record customer name, phone, or car license plate for Drive-thru.
Dispatch order directly to kitchen or expo station.
Settle immediately using fast cash or integrated card terminal.

slides.heading: U5 — Delivery, Online & Courier
slides.note: Centralized delivery board prevents aggregator order dispatch delays.
steps: Open Delivery module to manage in-house fleet orders.
Assign delivery drivers and track dispatch status.
Switch to Online view to manage aggregator orders (HungerStation, Jahez).
Monitor Courier pickup board for platform driver handovers.
Generate QR digital menu links for in-store guest ordering.

slides.heading: U6 — Kitchen Display System (KDS)
slides.note: Eliminates paper KOT tickets and accelerates order preparation times.
steps: Open Kitchen screen on kitchen display terminals.
Review incoming preparation tickets categorized by prep station.
Track elapsed ticket timers with visual color alerts.
Bump completed orders to advance them to the expo station.
Flag '86' sold-out items to immediately block front-of-house ordering.

slides.heading: U7 — Masters Management Hub
slides.note: Masters hub provides comprehensive menu creation and dish engineering.
steps: Access Masters hub from left navigation.
Manage parent food categories and sub-categories.
Configure dishes, selling prices, and kitchen department routing.
Define item customizers, add-on groups, and combo meals.
Sync master updates across all till stations in real time.

slides.heading: U8 — Back Office Hub
slides.note: Back Office provides managers with complete end-of-day audit controls.
steps: Access Back Office for daily management and fiscal oversight.
Review today's Sales Ledger and cashier shift drawers.
Execute official Branch Day Close procedures.
Track staff attendance through Time Clock.
Audit system voids, discounts, and employee privilege roles.
